summary: current_exe() error is discarded with .ok(); the user-visible reason omits the cause
evidence: lib.rs:31-33 .ok() then .and_then(...); reason string at lib.rs:37
failure_scenario: current_exe() fails: status shows a generic reason with no error detail. Safe behaviour (engine unavailable), diagnosis only.
